C-74.Name: Post-review stabilization reconciliation: close C-72 and settle the change-lifecycle ledger
C-74.Summary: C-72 executed and closed its four-corner review (rounds F and G consecutively clean), but its own BaselineAssertions describe the pre-reconciliation drift, so the active lint boundary keeps reporting four consumed baseline errors and demands a supersede/replan. Close C-72 the compliant way: a small successor bundle records the disposition and the post-review stabilization states, then moves C-72 intact to the archive. The approved C-72 plan is never retro-edited.
C-74.ApprovalBasis: Owner instruction on 2026-10-20: C-72 is stale relative to the post-review changes; grace status shows 4 assertion errors and requires supersede/replan; create a small successor C-74 — post-review stabilization reconciliation — to fix the current states and close C-72, instead of editing the approved plan retroactively.
C-74.ProblemEvidence: grace lint --assertions current (2026-10-20, this session) reports exactly four errors, all from .grace/changes/active/C-72/plan.xml BaselineAssertions: two MustContain on .grace/graph/runtime.xml for the stale pre-fix paths (src-tauri/src/shortcuts/mod.rs, src-tauri/src/mt_paths/mod.rs), one MustContain on docs/release-trains/2.5.x-next.md for the pre-acceptance C-TABLE-FOOTER wording, and one MustExist on .grace/changes/active/C-34/plan.xml which C-72 itself archived. These assertions encode the drift C-72 was approved to remove; they are consumed, not violated.

Goals.Goal: C-72 is closed by evidence-backed archival (executed; post-execution four-corner rounds F and G consecutively clean in its ReviewLog), with the bundle intact at .grace/changes/archive/C-72/.
The active lint boundary drops the four consumed C-72 baseline errors; no new error appears.

The post-review stabilization states are recorded in one evidence file: FIX-003..FIX-007 owner-accepted on the isolated bae95a97 artifact and queued; FIX-008 owner acceptance failed and reopened; FIX-010 and FIX-011 reported with the owner-approved action model; C-TABLE-FOOTER partially accepted with the Fit to page defect open; C-73 approved and landing; every repair coordinated through EP-2.5X-FOLLOWUPS-2026-10-20.
Train bookkeeping stays honest: acceptance, queueing, candidate freeze and publication remain separate, and nothing here admits a release.

Constraints.Constraint: Move C-72 byte-identical: no content edit of spec.xml, plan.xml, baseline.json or evidence.json during or after the move.
No graph, verification or source edits: the owning waves already updated the routed current-state documents; this bundle only settles change lifecycle.
Sequential execution; no parallel change bundle runs while C-74 is open.
English-only artifacts; no secrets, owner-private data, absolute home paths or release action.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No repair of FIX-008, FIX-010, FIX-011, FIX-012 or the C-TABLE-FOOTER Fit defect — each gets its own approved bundle per the follow-up epic.
No new acceptance, queueing or candidate decision; no version bump, tag, publication, store upload or tap update.
No rewrite of archived history or of the frozen GRACE 3 provenance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .grace/changes/archive/C-72/ contains spec.xml, plan.xml, baseline.json and evidence.json byte-identical to the last active revision, and .grace/changes/active/C-72/ no longer exists.
grace lint --path . --assertions current reports zero errors; pre-existing warnings may remain but no new one is introduced.

C-74 evidence.json records the C-72 disposition (archive-complete, with the rounds-F/G clean review basis) and the post-review stabilization states with pointers to their owning documents, without inventing any acceptance.
grace status --path . --with modules --json executes and lists C-74 among active changes with no structural complaint about the archived bundle.

AffectedAreas.Area: .grace/changes/active/C-74/ (new bundle); .grace/changes/active/C-72/ → .grace/changes/archive/C-72/ (intact move). No graph, verification, source or train edits.
